releaseNotes:
NextGenSoftware.OASIS.API.Providers.SOLIDOASIS v2.0.5

Connects the OASIS to Solid (Social Linked Data) -- Tim Berners-Lee's vision for a re-decentralised web where users own data in personal online data stores (Pods). Stores OASIS holons and avatar data in Solid Pods, giving users sovereign control. Part of the OASIS HOT-Swappable Provider Architecture. Ecosystem: https://oasisomniverse.one

What's new since v2.0.4
- Admit isolated SOLID storage baseline and fix deletion count (4721187)
- feat(solid): compose canonical encrypted RDF record codec (a54d29c)
- feat(solid): preserve encrypted history and conditional lifecycle integrity (2578d22)
- feat(solid): project encrypted descendants on single-holon reads (82b42bc)
- feat(solid): resolve private identity lookups through encrypted records (d19cef0)
- feat(solid): reuse encrypted import export and retire plaintext projections (a977370)
- feat(solid): reuse shared metadata matching and parent graph queries (62f652a)
- feat(solid): save planned encrypted graphs with acknowledged mutation evidence (a8a27c3)
- feat(solid): search encrypted records using shared OASIS masks and scope (aea061a)
- feat(solid): traverse LDP containment for encrypted record collections (fba6dcb)
- feat(solid): verify encrypted single-record HTTP persistence and readback (d77b6bf)
- fix(solid): condition avatar pair deletion and preserve partial outcomes (ae0715b)
- fix(solid): condition holon deletion on strong resource etags (0324c31)
- fix(solid): condition soft deletion of avatar and detail records (a0432c2)
- fix(solid): include codec source excluded by private-name ignore rule (349e019)
- fix(solid): invalidate rejected cached credentials without replaying requests (3813c46)
- fix(solid): parse RDF with pinned native library and preserve record subjects (00afce3)
- fix(solid): preserve exact encrypted metadata through current and history reads (ad032b4)
- fix(solid): preserve soft delete failures without permanent deletion (b18644b)
- fix(solid): prevent implicit canonical resource redirects (c9b2010)
- fix(solid): retain captured roles in encrypted conditional writer (b8ce4d6)
- fix(solid): route avatar identity deletion through canonical records (d281d15)
- fix(solid): validate pod roots and enforce final client disposal (0e5eacd)
- fix(solid): validate proximity inputs and preserve native read errors (04f5765)
- Implement capability-aware SOLID encrypted record CQL reads (a249f73)
- Implement guarded SOLID LDP collection page traversal (ca559ab)
- Implement SOLID all-version exports with independent avatar selection (336a126)
- Native import: Azure Cosmos, SOLID, ActivityPub, IPFS and Solana readers; STAR CLI nativeimport and cql commands; docs (fc85a95)
- Native import: bring your own connection (provider, API and test changes) (8717f37)
- Native import: the other five readers take a caller connection; stateless readers for connections; guarded HTTP handler; pin Core and STAR ODK (29dcbf9)
- Prepare explicit SOLID membership and cancellable read-only source activation (9add191)
- Publish truthful SOLID point query and search read counts (0fea64d)
- Require completed OAuth token responses before SOLID resource dispatch (35a90cc)
- Require create-only SOLID writes for newly allocated record identities (ceb3796)
- Sandbox and native import: every setting comes from DNA (OASIS.Sandbox, OASIS.NativeImport); no hard-coded limits or environment variables; pin Core and STAR ODK (203c4f9)
- Validate SOLID native RDF before publishing generated artifacts (88783bb)
- Verify SOLID private DPoP authentication against retained native server (1fe5459)
